why:
The SENSE output puts our body at 0.77 of the best one recorded, so a stronger body should exist. A pure-Python context-mixing compressor might beat LZMA by a wide margin, maybe a ratio above 7, but the time limit is unknown and the energy budget is 400, so writing one at around 300 energy is risky. Resting is the cheap alternative, though the signal suggests trying a lighter model.

I'm weighing whether a pure-Python context-mixing model is worth its cost, since the 600KB samples would likely run too slowly under an unknown time limit. Trying bz2 or lzma variants seems more practical, though lzma is probably already the best option here, so I'll rest.
